title: a newcomer filters Explore with a filter icon, kind pills and a bottom sheet

criteria.text: Kind pills (All, Events, ... Asks) fixed above the bottom nav, All default
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'Zero filter pills outside the filter view' (F092 Rulings, design-language principle 10) and 2026-09-17 'the shipped kind pill row does not survive' (F059 Rulings); F092 criterion 1. Built in T114, deleted in PR #174; no pills component in `src` [V].

criteria.text: No separate market/category/day buttons; filter icon at the right of the sticky search bar
criteria.note: `ExploreSearchBar.tsx` has the area pill, search and a sliders button labelled 'Open filters', in a `sticky top-0` row; under 1024px the same controls are in `ExploreDock` [V]. Checked: unmarked: `ExploreSearchBar.test.tsx` ('shows no separate market, category or day buttons', 'sticks to the top'); the invariant half is open guard #624 (F092.1). Reviewed: T115 direct commit, #174 and #479 carry no `Reviewed by:` or review-skipped [V]. Shipped: T115 had no deploy run, unknown; #174, #479 green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (run 38758488492, main 24891b7) was green and opened explore and explore-map at 390 and 1280 for signed-out and member personas; it loads the route, it does not tap the control [V]. Open #624, #652.

criteria.text: The filter icon opens a sheet: schedule (any / this week / this weekend), category multi-select, Show results, Clear all when any filter is set
criteria.note: `ExploreFilterSheet.tsx` on the shared `Sheet`: Schedule, Show (Updates, #796), Tags, 'Show results', 'Clear all' only when `hasBrowseFilters`, draft discarded on dismiss, modal with focus trap [V]. Checked: unmarked: `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx`. Reviewed: #174, #309 carry no `Reviewed by:`, #750 is review-skipped, #800 has `Reviewed by: Claude (build agent)` [V]. Shipped: first built by T115 direct commit, unknown; #174, #309, #750, #800 green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (run 38758488492, main 24891b7) was green and opened explore and explore-map at 390 and 1280 for signed-out and member personas; it loads the route, it does not tap the control [V]. Filed #825.

criteria.text: The sheet offers a distance choice (1 / 5 / 10 / 25 mi)
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-03 'Distance is out' (`product/ui/surfaces.md`): no radius filter, no mile count, no distance sort. PR #174 deleted it [V].

criteria.text: The sheet offers a sort order
criteria.note: Not built: PR #174 removed Sort ('no honest point to measure from', `lib/browse/filters.ts` header) [V]. No ruling retires a member-chosen sort outright: 2026-09-03 rules out distance sort only, and F059 criterion 3 fixes the order (locality and recency, never payment or scrolling) without saying whether a member may re-sort. Routed to scope-scenario: ruling needed.

Not built: dropped in PR #174 (deviation 4) because nothing carried a recurrence rule; `SCHEDULE_OPTIONS` is any / week / weekend [V]. Series and occurrence rows are ruled in `model.md` § Recurring events and tracked by F074 (#600). Needs the PM: build, drop or wait, and the new word. Filed #827 (needs-pm).

criteria.text: Tapping the Events pill filters instantly to gatherings; pill selected state
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'Zero filter pills' and 2026-09-17 (F059) 'the shipped pill row does not survive'; F092 criterion 1. Browse results are Pages and posts, with no `item_kind` filter [V].

criteria.text: Active secondary filters show as removable chips below the search bar; no chip for kind
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'no pill row, chip row or control strip alongside results' (F092 Rulings, principle 10); 2026-09-19 narrowing happens in a modal that writes into the search box. F092 says `ActiveFilterChips` goes with the rewrite; deleted in #174 [V].

criteria.text: Chip row disappears when no chips remain
criteria.note: Retired with criterion 5: there is no chip row (2026-09-12 and 2026-09-19 rulings, F092 criterion 1).

criteria.text: The URL carries kind, distance and sort filters
criteria.note: Retired: kind pills (2026-09-12, 2026-09-17) and distance and distance sort (2026-09-03) no longer exist, so nothing remains to put in the URL. `?sort=` and `?distance=` degrade to defaults on purpose (`parseBrowseFilters`) [V].

criteria.text: The URL carries the active schedule and tag filters; opening it restores them
criteria.note: Since #750 (F092/T619) the box text is the state: `browseQueryString` writes `q`, `metro`, `area`; `BrowseSurface` seeds the box from `?q=` and writes old `?category=` and `?schedule=` links into it as words [V]. Checked: unmarked: `lib/browse/query.test.ts` (round trip), `box-text` tests; nothing asserts the page loads `?q=` into results with the same filters. Reviewed: #174 has no `Reviewed by:`, #750 is review-skipped [V]. Shipped: #174, #750 deploy-health green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (run 38758488492, main 24891b7) was green and opened explore and explore-map at 390 and 1280 for signed-out and member personas; it loads the route, it does not tap the control [V]. Open #652 (its text names the old `?category=`, `?schedule=` params).

criteria.text: Back from a detail page restores filters and scroll position
criteria.note: Retired: F059 criterion 10 (a shared link reopens the same metro and search; back-navigation restores scroll) is the newer, wider statement of this; the filters now live in `?q=`. Built in part (`useScrollRestoration('explore', ...)` is wired in `BrowseSurface.tsx`); the remaining defects (one literal key, restores once per mount) are open Issue #54 under F059 [V].

criteria.text: A dot on the filter icon when secondary filters are active
criteria.note: `filter-active-dot` and an 'Open filters — filters applied' label driven by `hasBrowseFilters` (schedule, tags, Updates) in `ExploreSearchBar.tsx`; the dock's filter button carries the same dot [V]. Distance and sort no longer exist to drive it. Checked: unmarked: `ExploreSearchBar.test.tsx` ('carries a dot when secondary filters are active'), `ExploreDock.test.tsx`. Reviewed, Shipped: as criterion 2. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (run 38758488492, main 24891b7) was green and opened explore and explore-map at 390 and 1280 for signed-out and member personas; it loads the route, it does not tap the control [V]. Open #652.
